achievables.objective: Verify repository lineage, PR state, approved artifacts, runtime, resource limits, and SAFE-A reproducibility.
achievables.whyItMatters: Prevents scientific work from running on an incorrect parent or unreproducible environment.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Audit current GitHub/repository/runtime/cache state and reproduce the frozen SAFE-A load path.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Second source for PR/commit state and independent checkpoint hash verification.

achievables.objective: Extract frozen SAFE-A 512-D pre-fc1 embeddings and determine whether missed generator families retain non-real structure.
achievables.whyItMatters: Decides whether a small SAFE-B head is scientifically justified or whether an independent specialist is required.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Run SAFE-A on approved real, SAFE-easy, Seedream-4, Imagen-4, public FLUX.1, and consumed Cloudflare FLUX.1 samples; save embeddings and scores.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Repeat selected rows through an independent model-hook or deterministic embedding reader and verify hashes/statistics.

achievables.objective: Conditionally test a tiny frozen-backbone SAFE-B head only if representation analysis shows plausible separation.
achievables.whyItMatters: Tests cheap domain rescue without modifying SAFE-A or introducing a large learned ensemble.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Use family-held-out splits and a simple linear head; include a predeclared escalation rule for a tiny MLP only if linear underfits.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Independent negative confirmation split and exact rerun of a held-out family.

achievables.objective: Map the actual SAFE-A JPEG failure cliff across quality, encoder, subsampling, and compound transformations on frozen project media.
achievables.whyItMatters: A defensible eligibility boundary requires real encoded descendants, not numeric toy matrices.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Run frozen SAFE-A over original, Q100-Q50, multiple subsampling modes, two encoder paths, and predeclared compound transforms.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Independent encoder/tool metadata comparison and rerun of representative descendants.

achievables.objective: Measure phase, FFT, DCT, quantization-aware, and block-boundary features on the same real media pairs.
achievables.whyItMatters: Determines whether a lightweight Lythaus-owned cue survives compression and provides unique rescue.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Run frozen feature extraction on original/JPEG/compound descendants and compare stability, discrimination, and SAFE-miss rescue.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Cross-check numerical outputs against NumPy/SciPy or fixed fixtures and rerun representative samples.

achievables.objective: Validate the deterministic JPEG inspector over the complete generated matrix and an independent decoder/tool.
achievables.whyItMatters: Separates reliably measurable current bytes from probabilistic compression-history claims.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Parse every generated descendant and compare format, dimensions, DQT, sampling, progressive state, markers, and quality estimate to known parameters.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Pillow/libjpeg/OpenCV/Sharp metadata comparison plus byte inspection for disagreements.

achievables.objective: Replace placeholder literature fields with exact primary-source extraction for the 10-12 core methods.
achievables.whyItMatters: Prevents transferring unsupported paper claims into Lythaus architecture decisions.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Read primary papers/official code and extract exact data, degradation, metrics, ablations, compute, and rights.
requiredValidation: NOT REPORTED BY AUTHORS where appropriate
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Compare paper tables against official code/readme or a second primary artifact where available.

achievables.objective: Determine whether public and consumed Cloudflare FLUX.1 differ only at SAFE-A head output or across the full embedding.
achievables.whyItMatters: Quantifies unresolved provider/domain risk without retuning or touching FLUX.2.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Compare approved public/Cloudflare embeddings, centroids, distances, variance, and score relationships.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Recompute aggregate distances from the external embedding artifact.

achievables.objective: Derive an evidence-grade input eligibility proposal from measured SAFE, JPEG, phase/DCT, PNG-history, and camera-JPEG results.
achievables.whyItMatters: Defines honest scope without treating a lossless container as proof of an uncompressed history.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Compare native camera JPEG, recompressed camera JPEG, JPEG-to-PNG, genuine PNG, and synthetic transformations under the frozen measurements.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Apply proposal to held-out descendants not used to derive the boundary.

achievables.objective: Make every run reproducible and pass focused plus historical validation without weakening contracts.
achievables.whyItMatters: 110% completion requires independent checks, clean leakage controls, and auditable commands.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Run focused tests, historical authenticity suites, type/scope/security/schema checks, and exact rerun samples.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: Second-run hashes and independent metric/decoder checks.

achievables.objective: Publish the complete research result as an unmerged stacked continuation PR without production changes.
achievables.whyItMatters: Preserves reviewability, lineage, and explicit separation between research evidence and authorization.
achievables.requiredExperiment: Commit only sanitized artifacts/code/tests and open the stacked PR from WP007J.
achievables.requiredIndependentCrossCheck: GitHub PR metadata and local commit/diff comparison.
